title.zh: 单值接合的共同操作结构
title.en: Common operational structure for functional joining

claim.zh: 固定输入对的结果至多一个时，两份精确且约简的全情境说明具有相同的诱导部分操作，并在已用代码上有唯一的同片段对齐对应。
claim.en: When a fixed input pair has at most one result, two exact reduced accounts of all joining contexts carry the same induced partial operation, with a unique same-fragment-aligned correspondence on used codes.

hypotheses.zh: Functional J；全部有限单孔接合情境；双方 Exact 与 Reduced。
hypotheses.en: Functional J; all finite single-hole joining contexts; Exact and Reduced for both accounts.

correspondence.zh: 片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。
correspondence.en: Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

detail.zh: 接续允许多结果但丰富检验并明示有限纤维；范围不同，旧结果保留。
detail.en: The continuation allows multiple outcomes but enriches tests and states finite fibers; the distinct older scope remains.

detail.zh: 不同载体的保留引用形成对应已在新范围内实查；不是回写本结果的证明范围。
detail.en: Retained-reference formation across different carriers is checked at its new scope; it does not rewrite this result’s proof scope.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 不要求结果纤维的另加有限性；不恢复内部历史。多结果扩展改变检验范围，不能反写旧定理或宣称全部世界唯一。
detail.en: No separate finite-fiber premise; internal histories are not recovered. The multivalued extension changes the test scope and neither rewrites this theorem nor establishes uniqueness of whole worlds.

limitations.zh: 不要求结果纤维的另加有限性；不恢复内部历史。多结果扩展改变检验范围，不能反写旧定理或宣称全部世界唯一。
limitations.en: No separate finite-fiber premise; internal histories are not recovered. The multivalued extension changes the test scope and neither rewrites this theorem nor establishes uniqueness of whole worlds.

validation_scope.zh: 所列 Lean 源码与成功冻结回执逐字哈希绑定；本轮223项审计含26项新声明。旧功能性定理信用此前166项回执，未冒充新证明。
validation_scope.en: Listed Lean sources bind by exact hash to successful frozen receipts. This round checks 223 declarations including 26 new ones. The older functional theorem credits its previous 166-audit receipt, not a new proof.

next_delta.zh: 复用有限条件程序与真实余项恢复；继续建立内部语法不同的说明之间余项、判断与实际形成关系的有据翻译，区分语义可判定与实际取得。
next_delta.en: Reuse finite guarded programs and coherent residual recovery; establish warranted residual/guard/formation translation between descriptions with different internal syntax, distinguishing semantic tests from actual acquisition.

history.en: 2026-10-08: continued the existing joining-context study; migrated completed claims separately and distinguished new connections from reuse.

history.en: 2026-10-09: reuse this result in finite-granularity continuation; preserve its claim, hypotheses and proof bindings. New prefix omission and resumption testing appear in the same study §§22–26.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。函数性结合的伙伴框架是确定的，通过相同检验已是相同，无需判定（Joining.common_operation）。外围的上下文即其动作路径所达（realizes_iff_trace），所以 unique_common_operational_structure 在脊柱上逐字成立（Joining.unique_common_operational_structure_by_core），无附加假设，公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）（外围原证明用到 propext）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. For a functional joining the partner frame is determined, and passing the same tests already is likeness, with no decision (Joining.common_operation). A context of the periphery realizes exactly what its course of moves reaches (realizes_iff_trace), so unique_common_operational_structure holds on the spine as stated (Joining.unique_common_operational_structure_by_core), with no added hypothesis and empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing) (the periphery proof uses propext). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.

20 October 2026, R32 (forwarders, copies and reading modules: pure forwarders removed, statements stated once, reading modules folded into the module they read): Proof bindings (Joining.lean, Presentations.lean) rebound to core receipt 20261019T231053.882924Z. Re-pointed after reading the change: Joining.lean, pure forwarders and copies removed (B10, B9), uses pointed at the law they restate; imports follow the folds; kept statements unchanged; Presentations.lean, takes as its final section PresentationFrames, the module reading it, folded in with declarations, names and statements unchanged; pure forwarders and copies removed where it had them. The claim is unchanged.
